@@U03814@@
and yet, knowing my place, I kept my eyes averted, looking here and there, for this and that, searching out roots, mosses and bark— acquainted as I am with their virtues— and so the loving pair were left to themselves.

@@U03816@@
To hear you tell it, there are whole worlds in there! Woods, meadows, brooks, lakes! Just listen to you!

@@U03818@@
Yes! And there are, you poor innocents! Unexplored depths no man has ever fathomed! Room upon room, court upon endless court, and I searched out every one with care. All at once, then, a burst of laughter echoes through the cavernous spaces. And when I look, I see a boy leaping from the lady’s lap to the man’s, from father to mother. And the cooing and caressing, the shouts and shrieks of love's silly banter, jesting and pleasure, this side and that! I was as good as deaf! He’s naked is what he is! A wingless spirit! Faunlike without animality! Leaping on the ground, the ground sends him skyward, and on the second or third bound he touches the vaulted roof!
translation:
@@U03814@@
然而，由于我知道自己的位置，所以我一直把目光移开，东张西望，寻找这个那个，寻找树根、苔藓和树皮——我熟悉它们的优点——于是这对恩爱的情侣就被留下了。

@@U03816@@
听你说，那里有整个世界！树林、草地、小溪、湖泊！听你的！

@@U03818@@
是的！还有，你们这些可怜的无辜者！人类从未探索过的未探索的深度！一个又一个房间，一个又一个无尽的法庭，我仔细地搜寻着每一个房间。突然，一阵笑声在空旷的空间里回响。当我看时，我看到一个男孩从女士的腿上跳到男人的腿上，从父亲跳到母亲的腿上。还有爱的咕咕声和爱抚，爱的愚蠢玩笑、戏谑和快乐的叫喊和尖叫，这边和那边！我当时就跟聋子一样！他就是赤身裸体！没有翅膀的精灵！像农牧神一样没有动物性！跳到地面上，地面将他送向天空，第二次或第三次跳跃时，他触及了拱形屋顶！
